title: [P1-M1-T1] DB schema: users, stores, user_store_roles, refresh_tokens
description:
## Goal
Foundation multi-store + multi-user cho POS.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Migration: users, stores, user_store_roles, refresh_tokens
- [ ] Role enum: cashier | manager | admin
- [ ] Seed 1 admin + 1 store demo

## Schema
- users: id, email, phone, password_hash, is_active, created_at
- stores: id, code, name, address, timezone, is_active
- user_store_roles: user_id, store_id, role
- refresh_tokens: id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked

## Tests
- [ ] migration up/down
- [ ] seed loads

## Agent handoff
Ava plan tables; Rex models+migration; Kai indexes & uniques.
